name: Attribute server-type discount config completeness (3-attribute key)
what_it_tests: Attribute-based adjustment keyed on Feature x Deployment x ServerType; a missing combination (e.g. {SFTP, OnPrem, NonProd}) yields no match so AttributeDiscount makes no change and net stays at list (also covers GoAnywhere Non-Production 50% rule)
proc_mechanism: AttributeBasedPrice step queries Attribute_Based_Adjustment_Decision_Table with 3-attribute key; no match -> no adjustment -> NetUnitPrice stays list
expected_behavior: All valid attribute combinations have config rows; {SFTP,OnPrem,NonProd} -> Net != list; Non-Production deployment -> Net = List x 0.5
